hints.content:
Function $\redD g$ is shifted $3$ units right relative to $\blueD f$. 



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A cubic graph f and its shifted graph g are on an x y coordinate plane. The x- and y- axes scale by one. Graph f passes through point (negative one, negative three). Graph g passes through point (two, negative three). An arrow points from (negative one, negative three) to (two, negative three).

hints.content:
This means the value of $\redD g$ at a number $x$ is the same as the value of $\blueD{f}$ at a number $3$ less than $x$. 

 What would this sentence look like as an equation?

question.content:
$\redD g$ is a transformation of $\blueD f$. The graph below shows $\blueD f$ as a solid blue line and $\redD g$ as a dotted red line.
